components.name: ShadProgressList
components.description: List of progress rows from data, for goals, budgets, quotas, onboarding steps and capacity: each row has a label (labelField), its value against a target ('$18,400 of $25,000': valueField, targetField, in valueFormat: auto, number, currency in currency, percent, compact), a progress bar, an optional status (statusField: a chip toned by its words, On track green, At risk amber, Over budget or Behind red; a status that only names a tone, success, warning, danger, info or neutral, colours the bar without a chip) and an optional trailing caption under the bar ('12 days left': captionField). The percentage is percentField when the data has one (0 to 100), else value / target; a row with a value and no target reads the value as the percentage. autoTone colours bars from their percentage when the row has no status: 'goal' green at 100%, 'limit' (budgets, quotas, storage) amber from 80% and red over 100%. showValues and showPercent pick the figures shown; barSize thin, default or thick; listStyle 'card' (bordered panel) or 'plain'. A click on a row exposes selectedItem and selectedItemId and fires onItemClicked (rows look clickable only when it is handled). Use a Stat or a Summary strip for one headline figure, a Progress for a single bar. Height: grows with its rows (about 64px a row, 76px with captions)

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.
authoringHints.usage: Goals, budgets, quotas, capacity and onboarding steps as rows of label, 'value of target' and a bar, in place of a table of percentages or a stack of ShadProgress widgets: data rows with labelField, valueField and targetField (or percentField 0 to 100 when the data already has a percentage; a value with no target is read as the percentage), valueFormat 'currency' (with currency) for budgets and 'number' for counts. statusField chips tone the bar by their words (On track green, At risk amber, Over budget or Behind red; a bare tone name success, warning, danger or info colours the bar with no chip); without a status, autoTone 'limit' turns budgets and quotas amber from 80% and red over 100%, 'goal' turns a target green at 100%. captionField is a short line under the bar ('12 days left', 'Renewals due in November'). listStyle 'plain' inside a card, 'card' on its own; barSize 'thin' for a dense side panel. onItemClicked with selectedItem opens details. About 64px per row, 76 with captions.
